findings.defect: production tree_gone defaulted to true without a liveness check
findings.resolution: verifyTreeGone() does a real OS liveness check of pgid + recorded descendant PIDs; true/false/UNKNOWN; teardown-false -> not SUCCESS

findings.defect: overall run deadline not enforced during a running worker
findings.resolution: run-deadline monitor during execution; earlier of per-job-timeout / hard-deadline wins; deadline-during-worker -> RUN_DEADLINE_EXPIRED

findings.defect: real CLI allow/deny tool argument parsing not established
findings.resolution: argv now passes INDIVIDUAL tool entries (variadic <tools...>), proven to parse via read-only --help/--version smoke (cli-parser-smoke-A.out); no model request
max_budget_usd now REQUIRED, finite, > 0; missing/zero/negative/NaN/Infinity refused; subscription_only is an additional condition, not a replacement

findings.defect: denied command/tool boundaries not semantically validated
findings.resolution: validator requires the deny-list to semantically cover git push, git merge, protected-main checkout/switch, gh pr merge, destructive reset, and permission bypass
